set.request: try making some full screen experiences, and experiment with full screen layouts, as they pertain to navigation. for example, full screen -> split screen -> 3 equal columns. full screen title slide -> launches a document in a column on the right. large, clean, simple... iterate through all the permutations
steps: scope: docs + code/layout/css skills, name the permutation list
scaffold /imagine/screens/ index + screens.css + the one children line
title slide -> document, and the inverse
deck: slides swapped in place, url per slide
set.outcome:
**Eight full-screen experiences at [/imagine/screens/](/imagine/screens/)** - 24 urls, all cold-loadable, 72 headless loads at 400/1920/3440 with zero console errors.

![Divide, four columns at 1920](/framework/ai/2026-08-29/screens-lab/shots/screens-divide-two-three-four-1920.png)

**The finding, in two words.** `/imagine/` is a columns host, so a screen here cannot be a shell - it is the width word `full`, which folds the rail and the index into the crumb strip. One rule in `screens.css` re-tunes `full`'s three tokens to `fill`'s arithmetic, and that single rule is the whole progressive division. After that: **`full` REPLACES** the screen you were on, **`fill` JOINS** it and the screens left divide the row evenly. Every experiment is which word each hop picks.

| | verdict |
|---|---|
| [Divide](/imagine/screens/divide/) | 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 columns, measured 1920/960/640/480 and 3440/1720/1147/860. Nothing re-renders. |
| [Stack](/imagine/screens/stack/) | The axes are NOT symmetrical: the height has no row to open into, so each band count is a screen that redraws, and a band has no url. |
| [Title Slide](/imagine/screens/title/) | 1920 -> 224 + 1696. The cover keeps its column and gives up the screen - one `:has()`, no second render. |
| [Peek](/imagine/screens/read/) | The inverse is the same two pages with the words swapped: 1696 + 224. Whichever page leads keeps the room. |
| [Deck](/imagine/screens/deck/) | `full` slides hide each other, so swap is free: a url per slide, arrows and clicks take the identical path, Back walks it backwards. |
| [Uneven](/imagine/screens/uneven/) | A BASIS is a share: 61.8/38.2 measured 1187/733 at 1920 and 2126/1314 at 3440 - the golden section at both, no grow weights. |
| [Quad](/imagine/screens/quad/) | The 2x2 stacks when its own column runs out (531px at 1920) and stays a 2x2 at 3440 (951px) - the box asked, not a guessed breakpoint. |
| [Mix](/imagine/screens/mix/) | Both axes compose: a cover beside a column that splits its own height, and the bands open a third column. |

**Two bugs found by the gesture probe.** A `keydown` bound in `activated()` outlives its screen - going deeper never deactivates an ancestor, so the deck host kept listening and ArrowRight on slide three walked *back* to two; one guard (`location.pathname !== this.url`) fixes it. And a column marked `default` is BUILT by its host, never routed to, so its `app` stays undefined and `this.app.router` threw - `Screen.go()` resolves it off `chain()[0]` instead. Noted for `core/Page`, not worked around there.

**Also measured:** `hides-nav` is already site-wide (the site root carries it and is an active-ancestor everywhere), so these screens do not need the word. No sighting of the `width: "full"` sidebar bug - `/imagine/` has no Sidebar. Nothing on a screen scrolls at any width; under 32em of row core pages one column at a time and every hop at 400 is a swipe, by design.

**Docs:** [readme](/imagine/screens/readme/) (the verdict table and the traps) - the record, including what was rejected and cut, is in `public/imagine/screens/doc/decisions.md`.

**Left, deliberately:** a vertical spine for the compressed cover (decoration, not information); a url per band (the Router lights one chain, so the url would name the column); re-weighting Uneven to land on exactly 3:2:1 (shares compose instead, ~3.1 : 1.9 : 1); a fifth Divide hop (a quarter is already 480px at 1920).

**Shots:** 27 keepers at 400/1920/3440 in `shots/`.
